basis.who_pays: All amounts are PER PERSON, SGD, planned. 1 SGD = 20,285 VND (open.er-api.com, rate dated 6 Oct 2026); USD converted at 1 USD = 25,965 VND. Room rates are halved because the two of you share a twin/double.
basis.scope: On-the-ground only. The international SIN-HAN return is in this file as category 'flights' but its amount is written as a text range, not a number, so it is shown in the list without inflating the total - that is deliberate, so the tracked figure stays comparable to the S$1,500/person cap. Scoot cabin-baggage and the 20 kg checked-bag add-on are not costed here (buy at booking); assume S$40-80 per person each way if you check a bag.
basis.peak_season_sensitivity: Every hotel figure is a 2026 guide 'typical' rate, not a quote. If the Old Quarter and Tam Coc price 30-50% above those figures over Christmas/NYE, accommodation goes from S$213 to roughly S$277-320 per person and the trip total moves to about S$1,042-1,085 - still S$415+ inside the cap. The S$522 of headroom exists for exactly this.
basis.verification: Every non-obvious line is sourced and dated in data/sources.md. Lines marked 'unverified' in their description are the researcher's or my own gaps, not estimates with a source behind them.

SIN (Changi) <-> Hanoi (HAN) return, per person, non-stop - PLANNING RANGE S$450-700, NOT VERIFIED
planned.notes: The amount is deliberately text, not a number: airline prices are a range, and putting a number here would silently inflate the on-the-ground budget the app tracks against S$1,500. NO LIVE FARE WAS EVER QUOTED for 24 Dec 2026 - 2 Jan 2027 - no booking engine was opened, and the brief forbids booking. 24 Dec-2 Jan is the single most expensive week of the year on this route. Verify before locking the dates; shifting departure to 26/27 Dec and the return to 3/4 Jan is usually materially cheaper but eats trip days. Multiply by 2 travellers. Scoot checked baggage is NOT included in Basic (20 kg on Value/Flex, up to 40 kg purchasable, max 32 kg per bag).
